assets.notes: Autotile set. road_5 is the known runtime center/fill (confirmed). The full 26-tile road kit exists elsewhere in the archive (VoidDesert road_1-26); CloverVillage holds only the 13-piece subset. Compass roles stay needs-verification — do not assign until the full kit is reviewed. Analysis: design/assets/road-autotile-roles.json; visual preview: /asset-catalog/autotile/ ROAD KIT RECOVERY PASS (2026-08-15): compared CV road_1-13 vs VoidDesert road_1-26 (design/assets/road-kit-recovery.json, preview /asset-catalog/autotile/recovery.html). Same structural kit and same earthen path family (color distance 32) but DIFFERENT tint — VoidDesert tiles are desert-gold with 0% green grass vs CV 3.6%; do not copy tiles in without recoloring. Of the 5 missing roles, 4 exist in VoidDesert (outer-corner-ne: road_7; inner-corner-n: road_2/15; inner-corner-e: road_6/19; inner-corner-s: road_8/21); edge-e exists in NO pack. CV duplicate candidates are all TRUE VARIANTS (46-88% pixels differ), none pixel-identical, and no CV tile is pixel-identical to any VD tile. Status: INCOMPLETE AUTOTILE KIT — candidate compass roles recorded below but topology stays needs-verification until a recolored/recovered kit is rendered. FINAL ROAD VERDICT (2026-08-15): Road Catalog Audit COMPLETE; Earthen Vine Path art kit INCOMPLETE — 5 assets required (see artTask). No further archive searching or catalog work can complete this set; edge-east exists in no pack. Existing Clover assets stay untouched. VoidDesert is structural reference only. Topology of the existing 13 tiles is verified by visual classification; the missing 5 tiles are an art asset gap, not a metadata problem.
